realProvidersEnabled.description: True when GEN3D_ENABLE_REAL_PROVIDERS resolves to "1" (process.env wins over the plugin .env).

HUNYUAN_API_KEY.description: Masked key (first4...last4, or *** when ≤ 8 chars) or null when unset. Never plaintext.

HUNYUAN_BASE_URL.description: Plaintext base URL (an address, not a secret) or null when unset.

MESHY_API_KEY.description: Masked key or null when unset. Never plaintext.

RODIN_API_KEY.description: Masked key or null when unset. Never plaintext.
